Hogwarts Great HallHarry Potter and the Philosopher's StoneFirst year at Hogwarts. First feast.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersPumpkin pastiesShortcrust half moons filled with roast pumpkin, feta and sageHow to make it600g pumpkin, diced1 tbsp olive oil100g feta, crumbled1 tbsp fresh sage, chopped1 pinch of nutmeg3 sheets of shortcrust pastry1 egg, beatenHeat the oven to 200°C. Toss the pumpkin in the oil and roast until soft.Mash with the feta, sage and nutmeg and cool.Cut the pastry into rounds, fill and fold into half moons, crimping the edges.Brush with egg and bake until golden.Trolley chocolate frogs with honeycombThe sweets trolley on the train to schoolHow to make itAs written, serves 4Milk chocolate frogs moulded around crunchy homemade honeycomb, each wrapped in a little paper card like the ones from the trolley.Line a tray with baking paper.Boil 150g caster sugar and 3 tbsp golden syrup to 150°C, then whisk in 2 tsp bicarb, pour onto the tray and leave to set for 30 minutes.Break into small crumbs.Melt 250g milk chocolate gently.Spoon a little into frog moulds, add a pinch of honeycomb, top with more chocolate and tap out the air.Chill 30 minutes, turn out and wrap each in paper.MainsGreat Hall honey chicken and YorkshiresHoney mustard glazed drumsticks with roast potatoes and Yorkshire puddingsHow to make it8 chicken drumsticks3 tbsp honey2 tbsp wholegrain mustard1kg potatoes, cut in chunks2 tbsp olive oil100g plain flour2 eggs250ml milk2 tbsp vegetable oil300g frozen peas30g butter1 cup gravyHeat the oven to 200°C. Mix the honey and mustard and coat the drumsticks.Toss the potatoes in the olive oil and roast with the chicken.Whisk the flour, eggs and milk into a batter and rest.Heat oil in muffin tins, pour in the batter and bake until puffed.Cook the peas with the butter and warm the gravy.Serve everything together.Hogwarts Christmas roast turkeyThe first proper Christmas Harry ever hasHow to make itAs written, serves 4Herb-buttered turkey breast roasted golden with chipolatas in bacon, roast potatoes, honey parsnips, cranberry sauce and a rich gravy.Heat the oven to 180°C.Rub a 1.5kg turkey breast roll with 50g butter mashed with sage and thyme and roast 75 minutes to 70°C inside, then rest.Wrap 12 chipolatas in half rashers of streaky bacon and roast for the last 30 minutes.Roast 1kg parboiled potatoes and 500g parsnips tossed in honey and oil at 200°C for 45 minutes.Make gravy with the tray juices, 1 tbsp flour and 400ml chicken stock.Serve with cranberry sauce.SweetsTreacle tartGolden syrup and lemon tart in sweet shortcrustHow to make it1 sheet of sweet shortcrust pastry400g golden syrup100g fresh white breadcrumbs1 lemon, zest and juiceclotted cream, to serveHeat the oven to 180°C. Line a tart tin with the pastry and chill briefly.Blind bake the case.Warm the golden syrup with the breadcrumbs, lemon zest and juice.Pour into the case and bake until just set.Cool slightly and serve each slice with clotted cream.Hogwarts rock cakesCrumbly fruit cakes with mixed spice. “You're a wizard, Harry.”How to make it125g cold butter, cubed250g self-raising flour75g caster sugar1 tsp mixed spice150g mixed dried fruit1 egg2 tbsp milkHeat the oven to 200°C and line a tray.Rub the butter into the flour, sugar and spice.Stir in the dried fruit, then bind with the egg and milk.Drop in rough piles on the tray and bake until golden.DrinksPumpkin juiceRoast pumpkin blended with apple juice, honey and cinnamon, served chilledHow to make it300g pumpkin, diced1 L cloudy apple juice1 tbsp honey1 pinch of ground cinnamonRoast the pumpkin at 200°C until soft and cool completely.Blend with the apple juice, honey and cinnamon until smooth.Strain through a sieve into a jug and chill well.
